# Site Rules — ThesisClaw

## Architecture

The `site/` folder contains two static sub-sites:

| Sub-site | Path | Audience | Hosting |
|---|---|---|---|
| Public judge page | `site/public/` | Hackathon judges | Cloudflare Tunnel (local port forwarding) |
| Private playbook | `site/playbook/` | You only | Local only |

## Rules

- **No external JavaScript libraries.** No CDN links. All assets must be bundled locally or inlined.
- **No server-side code.** Both sub-sites are purely static HTML + CSS + minimal vanilla JS.
- **Long-running stats.** The public page must display real statistics fetched from `stats.json` (generated by the worker). Judges need to see that the agent has been running for days.
- **Local port forwarding only.** There is no cloud VM for the public site. Cloudflare Tunnel (`cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:<port>`) exposes the static server. The tunnel URL goes into `MCP_TUNNEL_DOMAIN` in `.env`.
- **No thesis text on the public page.** Show analysis, short quotes (≤3 sentences), and links only. Never republish full papers.
- **Playbook stays local.** Never push `site/playbook/` to a public repo or serve it over Cloudflare.
